description: Display-metre derivation. Generated with real HMAC-SHA256 (OpenSSL 3.5.6). The displayed value is a function of (session_salt, local_peer_id, band) and NEVER of RSSI — that is the whole security property. See BANDING.md §6.1.
algorithm: seed   = HMAC-SHA256(key = session_salt, message = local_peer_id || band_ordinal_byte)
metres = clamp(metres, midpoint - span, midpoint + span)
session_salt_note: Fixed here for reproducibility. In production it is 32 CSPRNG bytes per Radar session, never persisted, never transmitted.

property_assertions.name: deterministic
property_assertions.note: Same (salt, peer, band) MUST always produce the same metres. Re-evaluating on every UI frame must not change the number.

property_assertions.name: independent-of-rssi
property_assertions.note: The derivation takes no RSSI input. A test that feeds different RSSI values within the same band MUST observe an unchanged displayed value. This is the anti-averaging property (BANDING.md §6.1).

property_assertions.name: within-band-range
property_assertions.note: For every band, output MUST fall inside band_display.range_m.

property_assertions.name: differs-across-sessions
property_assertions.note: A different session_salt MUST, with overwhelming probability, produce a different value for the same peer and band.
